author_review.reason: Author review for 4.6.98 (captain claude-s5, Nov 24 2026). Runtime files changed since v4.6.97: lumibot/brokers/broker.py, strategies/strategy.py, strategies/strategy_executor.py, brokers/schwab.py, brokers/schwab_request_pacer.py, data_sources/schwab_data.py, tools/speed_summary.py: Schwab live speed (idle order/account read skipping, batched quote reuse, chain reuse, submit re-attach, pacer window, opt-in wake on fill, per-minute speed log); every new branch is guarded by IS_BACKTESTING_BROKER or is Schwab-only, so BacktestingBroker keeps its previous path (tests/test_live_idle_account_and_reattach.py, Schwab pacer and quote cache tests). lumibot/entities/order.py and entities/_status_clock.py: live-only status_updated_at/status_checked_at/status_source attributes, off in backtests and absent from Order.to_dict, so serialized orders the retained cases see are unchanged. lumibot/data_sources/data_source.py, backtesting/alpaca_backtesting.py, backtesting/routed_backtesting.py, backtesting/thetadata_backtesting_pandas.py, tools/ibkr_history_health.py: daily valuation and split-check speed-ups with equivalence tests against the original logic (tests/test_backtest_per_iteration_costs.py, tests/test_required_history_fast_path.py); the retained in-memory Pandas fixtures have no corporate actions and never construct Alpaca, routed or IBKR sources. lumibot/tools/ibkr_helper.py: IBKR forex/spot metals read Midpoint history; never reached. lumibot/strategies/_strategy.py, tools/indicators.py, tools/report_speedups.py, tools/backtest_telemetry.py: end-of-run reports (import prewarm, QuantStats aggregation cache, risk-free rate prefetch) and telemetry fields, byte-identical report numbers; the retained fixtures bypass the full strategy runner and reports. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Update for candidate 6511d683825f: lumibot/strategies/strategy.py _refresh_account_before_order_action returns when the strategy has no broker attached (tests/test_crypto_future_close_position.py null-order check); backtests and the retained fixtures still return at the IS_BACKTESTING_BROKER check, unchanged. 909 Schwab/order/speed tests and 392 backtest speed/report tests passed on this candidate. Previous review, still true: Release 4.6.97 author review (captain claude-kalshi, Nov 24 2026): the unpublished 4.6.96 source plus KalshiBacktesting.search_markets (public pass-through with the existing visibility rule) and a new Kalshi example file. The retained cases never construct KalshiBacktesting, a prediction_contract asset or the example. Previous: Release 4.6.96 author review. The retained catalog binds the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker, so it does not construct the optional Webull adapter, use Webull account data or select Webull daily history. The cash-sized order hook returns False on BacktestingBroker and leaves ordinary validation unchanged. The same fixture bypasses the full strategy runner and its new provenance output, never invokes the blocking wait helpers, and has no perpetual, Schwab, IPO listings, or indicator drawing actions. The shared N-minute window optimization passed frame identity tests. No agent tool, prompt, skill, model wrapper, or fixture changed. The catalog binding test, wait and history controls, data provenance, listings, drawings, and Schwab account regressions passed. No new inference is claimed. This retains the previous author-reviewed changes. The later broker reconciliation, restart ownership and order-detail changes only run on live broker synchronization and are bypassed by BacktestingBroker. The SEC changes affect rebuilding EDGAR tables and selecting visible prospectuses and delistings; neither retained case uses listings. Focused broker, historical replay and SEC tests verify those paths separately. The delisting repair changes only the EDGAR listings builder and does not affect the retained Pandas strategy fixtures. Requiring a price on Webull fill observations leaves other brokers' existing observation semantics and the simulated broker unchanged. The live multi-leg smart-limit uncertainty handler runs only after an early return for BacktestingBroker. Other changes are to Webull order, credential and SEC listing readback paths unused by the retained fixtures.
